name: synthica-platform
description: Synthica platform monorepo — marketing site, journal backend, and editor/researcher dashboards.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix dashboards install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,dashboards,website -c blue,magenta,green "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:dashboards" "npm run dev:website"
